supplements.title: Type 2 diabetes remission in gynaecologic oncology patients completing an acute preoperative weight loss protocol: a case series.
supplements.summary: Gynaecologic cancer patients with obesity who lost weight before surgery experienced remission or improvement in their type 2 diabetes.

supplements.title: Berberine alleviates radiation-induced intestinal injury by inhibiting cellular senescence.
supplements.summary: Berberine reduces intestinal damage from radiation therapy by preventing cells from aging prematurely.

supplements.title: Betulinic acid is associated with miR-21 modulation, apoptosis and redox changes in breast cancer cells: an in vitro and in silico study.
supplements.summary: Betulinic acid kills triple-negative breast cancer cells by reducing miR-21 levels and triggering apoptosis, especially when combined with doxorubicin.

supplements.title: Food-Derived Limosilactobacillus fermentum GR-3 Enhances Anti-PD-1 Immunotherapy Efficacy.
supplements.summary: A food-derived probiotic strain enhanced anti-PD-1 immunotherapy effectiveness in colorectal cancer while reducing treatment side effects.

supplements.title: Ginsenoside Rh2 inhibits non-small-cell lung cancer malignant progression through targeting AURKA.
supplements.summary: Ginsenoside Rh2 inhibits lung cancer growth and improves chemotherapy by targeting the AURKA protein.

supplements.title: Integrative multi-omics analysis identifies a core ferroptosis signature and validates resveratrol as a novel inducer in pancreatic cancer.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol induces ferroptosis in pancreatic cancer cells by targeting a key regulatory network involving six genes, offering a potential new treatment approach.

supplements.title: A novel hesperetin derivative DU12 targets cyclin-dependent kinase 17 (CDK17) to inhibit malignant progression of ovarian cancer.
supplements.summary: A new compound called DU12, derived from a natural flavonoid, stops ovarian cancer growth by blocking a protein called CDK17.

supplements.title: Powder bergamot juice attenuates skeletal muscle complications in an experimental model of metabolic syndrome.
supplements.summary: Bergamot juice powder reduced skeletal muscle problems in metabolic syndrome, potentially improving glucose control and preventing diabetes.

supplements.title: Emerging concepts, hot topics, and open questions in today's pancreatic cancer research.
supplements.summary: Pancreatic cancer researchers identify emerging approaches—including microenvironment studies, immunotherapy, and microbiome research—to improve survival rates.

supplements.title: The effects of a powdered meal replacement intake on inflammation, gut microbiota, and metabolism compared to habitual diet in people with excess body weight - results from a randomized controlled trial.
supplements.summary: A powdered meal replacement reduced inflammation and improved metabolism in overweight people compared to their regular diet.

supplements.title: Multidimensional Proteomics Reveals the Pro-apoptotic Mechanism of Platycodin D: Targeting RFC4 to Regulate the Notch Signaling Axis in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer.
supplements.summary: Platycodin D, a plant compound, kills non-small cell lung cancer cells by targeting a protein that controls growth signals.

supplements.title: Acute and subchronic toxicity studies of polysaccharide components from Trametes robiniophila Murr (Huaier) in Sprague-Dawley rats.
supplements.summary: Researchers tested purified polysaccharides from Huaier fungus for safety in rats, supporting its use against hepatocellular carcinoma.

supplements.title: Innovations in Obesity Treatment: Beyond Adipose Tissue Dysfunction.
supplements.summary: Obesity drives cancer through chronic inflammation and insulin dysfunction; new treatments targeting appetite hormones and fat metabolism show promise.

supplements.title: Integrating Network Pharmacology and Experimental Validation to Elucidate the Role of Huaier in Attenuating Liver Fibrosis via the AKT Signalling Pathway.
supplements.summary: Huaier, a natural compound, reduces liver fibrosis by blocking the AKT protein pathway that activates scar-forming cells.

supplements.title: Mechanistic insights into 18β-glycyrrhetinic acid-induced apoptosis in SCC-9 cells revealed by TMT proteomics and network pharmacology.
supplements.summary: Licorice compound 18β-GRA kills tongue cancer cells by triggering apoptosis, cell cycle arrest, and oxidative stress through PI3K/AKT pathway inhibition.

off_label.title: Pre-treatment of cabozantinib prior to hypofractionated radiotherapy increases immunomodulatory effects and tumor size reduction in a 4T1 breast cancer murine model.
off_label.summary: Combining cabozantinib with radiotherapy reduces breast cancer tumors and boosts anti-tumor immune responses in mice.

off_label.title: Prenatal Diagnosis and Management of Kaposiform Hemangioendothelioma With Kasabach-Merritt Phenomenon: Imaging Features and First Experience With Maternal Sirolimus Therapy.
off_label.summary: Pregnant woman received a drug called sirolimus to treat a rare blood vessel tumor in the fetus, successfully managing a life-threatening bleeding complication.

off_label.title: Emerging concepts, hot topics, and open questions in today's pancreatic cancer research.
off_label.summary: Pancreatic cancer researchers identify emerging approaches—including microenvironment studies, immunotherapy, and microbiome research—to improve survival rates.

off_label.title: The retinol metabolizing enzyme DHRS3 coordinates antigen presentation, endothelial stability, and cholesterol metabolism to suppress hepatocellular carcinoma progression.
off_label.summary: DHRS3 protein suppresses liver cancer growth by boosting immunity and blocking metastasis, with a drug combination showing promise.

off_label.title: Innovations in Obesity Treatment: Beyond Adipose Tissue Dysfunction.
off_label.summary: Obesity drives cancer through chronic inflammation and insulin dysfunction; new treatments targeting appetite hormones and fat metabolism show promise.

off_label.title: Discovery of novel anthraquinone-based P2X7R antagonist that reinvigorates anti-tumor immunity and overcomes PD-1 resistance in breast cancer.
off_label.summary: A new breast cancer drug candidate blocks P2X7R to shrink tumors and restore immune response, even overcoming resistance to existing immunotherapy.

off_label.title: Emerging trends in implication of nanocarriers in repolarization of tumor associated macrophages for improved triple negative breast cancer therapy.
off_label.summary: Nanocarriers can reprogram tumor-supporting immune cells to fight triple negative breast cancer more effectively.

off_label.title: Combination of ivermectin and metformin promotes autophagy in MCF‑7 cells by inhibiting phosphorylation of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway.
off_label.summary: Combining ivermectin and metformin kills breast cancer cells by triggering autophagy through increased oxidative stress and pathway inhibition.

off_label.title: The role of ATP synthase subunit e (ATP5I) in mediating the metabolic and antiproliferative effects of metformin in cancer cells.
off_label.summary: Metformin fights pancreatic cancer and osteosarcoma by targeting ATP5I protein, disrupting cancer cell energy production and blocking growth.

off_label.title: LKB1 Loss Sensitizes Lung Tumor Spheres to Mitomet-Induced Ferroptosis, and These Effects are Enhanced by mTOR Inhibition.
off_label.summary: LKB1-mutant lung cancer stem cells die when treated with mitomet and mTOR inhibitors through ferroptosis, a new therapeutic approach.

off_label.title: Inhibition of ceramide synthesis ameliorates body wasting in a cancer cachexia model.
off_label.summary: Blocking ceramide production in the liver reduces muscle wasting in cancer cachexia, offering a potential new treatment approach.

off_label.title: Repurposing Resmetirom to Suppress MASLD/MASH-HCC in the Dysmetabolic Era.
off_label.summary: Resmetirom, a drug approved for fatty liver disease, may help prevent or treat liver cancer by reducing inflammation and improving metabolic health.

off_label.title: Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme Inhibitors and Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk in Patients With Chronic Hepatitis B and Hypertension: A Nationwide Dose-Response Cohort Study.
off_label.summary: Blood pressure drugs called ACE inhibitors may lower liver cancer risk in hepatitis B patients with hypertension.

off_label.title: Harnessing Cuproptosis for Antitumor Immunity: A Review of Current Evidence and Therapeutic Strategies.
off_label.summary: Triggering copper-driven cell death could enhance immune checkpoint inhibitor effectiveness across multiple cancer types.

off_label.title: Dose-Response Relationship of Niclosamide and Metformin Combination in ApcMin/+ Mice: An Integrated In Vivo and Pharmacokinetic Modeling Study.
off_label.summary: Combining niclosamide and metformin reduces polyps in mice with familial adenomatous polyposis, a hereditary colorectal cancer condition.

biomarkers.title: Circular RNAs in tumorigenesis: an insight into recent research in biogenesis and targeted tumor therapy.
biomarkers.summary: Dysregulated circular RNAs show promise as cancer biomarkers and therapeutic targets across multiple tumor types.

biomarkers.title: KIBRA impairs DNA damage repair and suppresses osteosarcoma progression by inhibiting the Wnt/β-catenin signaling activity.
biomarkers.summary: KIBRA suppresses osteosarcoma growth by blocking a key cell signaling pathway and impairing cancer cells' DNA repair ability.

biomarkers.title: RBM15B-mediated m6A modification of FOXM1 activates the AURKA/TPX2 axis to promote epithelial-mesenchymal transition-driven endometrial cancer progression.
biomarkers.summary: RBM15B protein increases endometrial cancer progression by chemically modifying FOXM1 RNA, which activates a pathway promoting cancer spread.

biomarkers.title: Chemiluminescence resonance energy transfer-based method to investigate the platelet surface molecule in acute myocardial infarction.
biomarkers.summary: A new blood test method detects elevated platelet activation markers in acute heart attack patients, potentially improving diagnosis and risk assessment.

biomarkers.title: Neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy and postoperative acute hypoxemic respiratory failure in thoracic surgery: a multicentre cohort study.
biomarkers.summary: Immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy before lung cancer surgery may increase risk of serious breathing problems after the operation.

biomarkers.title: miR-4772-3p serves as a potential diagnostic and prognostic biomarker in septic acute kidney injury by targeting CISD2.
biomarkers.summary: miR-4772-3p is elevated in septic acute kidney injury and serves as a diagnostic and prognostic biomarker by targeting CISD2.

biomarkers.title: ATOX1 alleviates radiation-induced cardiac injury by modulating AMPK/NRF2 to inhibit myocardial oxidative stress and mitochondrial dysfunction.
biomarkers.summary: ATOX1 protein protects heart cells from radiation damage by activating a pathway that reduces harmful stress molecules and restores mitochondrial function.

biomarkers.title: CAR T-cell therapy-associated central hypothyroidism: a case of a novel onco-endocrine toxicity.
biomarkers.summary: CAR T-cell therapy for mantle cell lymphoma caused rare central hypothyroidism, likely from immune cells damaging the pituitary gland.

biomarkers.title: Metastases to the thyroid gland from uncommon primaries: a case series.
biomarkers.summary: Thyroid nodules from metastatic cancers can mimic primary thyroid cancer; immunohistochemistry helps identify the true cancer source.

biomarkers.title: PRX5 as a critical driver of colorectal cancer stemness and tumorigenicity.
biomarkers.summary: PRX5 protein drives colorectal cancer stem cell formation and tumor growth, offering a potential treatment target.

biomarkers.title: Statistical method for pooling categorical biomarker data from multi-center matched/nested case-control studies.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a statistical method to accurately combine categorical biomarker data from multiple studies while correcting for measurement differences between labs.

biomarkers.title: Screening for differentially expressed genes in retinoblastoma gene chips through the GEO database and validation in clinical settings.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified genes with abnormal expression in retinoblastoma tumors and confirmed these findings in actual patient samples.

biomarkers.title: Mitochondria-Targeted Zwitterionic Nanogels Trigger Photopyroptosis for Enhanced Cancer Therapy.
biomarkers.summary: Nanogels that naturally target mitochondria trigger cancer cell death when exposed to laser light, achieving 99.3% tumor inhibition with minimal toxicity.

biomarkers.title: [Testicular sex cord stromal tumors].
biomarkers.summary: Testicular sex cord stromal tumors are rare cancers, mostly benign but some aggressive; better recognition helps appropriate treatment.

biomarkers.title: [Giant cystic lymphangioma of the small bowel mesentery].
biomarkers.summary: Surgical removal cured a rare benign small bowel mesentery cyst (lymphangioma) with no recurrence after one year of follow-up.

trials.title: Relationship between spiritual pain, physical pain, and existential wellbeing among cancer patients: a correlational study.
trials.summary: Spiritual pain strongly affects cancer patients' overall well-being alongside physical pain, revealing an important gap in supportive care.

trials.title: Creative and Expressive Therapies in Head and Neck Cancer Nursing: A Scoping Review and Evidence Map.
trials.summary: Creative therapies like art and music may help improve quality of life and emotional well-being in head and neck cancer patients.

trials.title: A cohort study on inflammatory response and coagulation function changes in women with silver clip or silk ligation sterilisation.
trials.summary: Researchers studied how two tubal sterilization methods affect women's inflammation and blood clotting over time.

trials.title: Type 2 diabetes remission in gynaecologic oncology patients completing an acute preoperative weight loss protocol: a case series.
trials.summary: Gynaecologic cancer patients with obesity who lost weight before surgery experienced remission or improvement in their type 2 diabetes.

trials.title: Neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy and postoperative acute hypoxemic respiratory failure in thoracic surgery: a multicentre cohort study.
trials.summary: Immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy before lung cancer surgery may increase risk of serious breathing problems after the operation.

trials.title: CAR T-cell therapy-associated central hypothyroidism: a case of a novel onco-endocrine toxicity.
trials.summary: CAR T-cell therapy for mantle cell lymphoma caused rare central hypothyroidism, likely from immune cells damaging the pituitary gland.

trials.title: Triplet or Quadruplet Regimen Utilization and Overall Survival in Patients Diagnosed With Multiple Myeloma Between 2017 and 2023.
trials.summary: Multiple myeloma patients treated with three or four-drug combinations showed improved survival compared to standard treatments from 2017 to 2023.

trials.title: European Recommendations for Transitioning the Care of Patients With Multiple Myeloma Treated With B-Cell Maturation Antigen Bispecific Antibodies From Academic Hospitals to Community-Based Centers and for Outpatient Step-Up Dosing.
trials.summary: Researchers provide guidelines for safely treating multiple myeloma patients with new bispecific antibody drugs in community hospitals instead of academic centers.

trials.title: Effects of yoga on depressive symptoms in breast cancer patients: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
trials.summary: Yoga reduces depression symptoms in breast cancer patients and should be used alongside standard cancer treatments.

trials.title: Statistical method for pooling categorical biomarker data from multi-center matched/nested case-control studies.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a statistical method to accurately combine categorical biomarker data from multiple studies while correcting for measurement differences between labs.

trials.title: Screening for differentially expressed genes in retinoblastoma gene chips through the GEO database and validation in clinical settings.
trials.summary: Researchers identified genes with abnormal expression in retinoblastoma tumors and confirmed these findings in actual patient samples.

trials.title: Endometriosis and ovarian cancer: epidemiological evidence, molecular insights, and clinical decision-making.
trials.summary: Women with endometriosis have twice the ovarian cancer risk, but combined oral contraceptives significantly reduce this cancer risk long-term.

trials.title: Favorable pathological response with enfortumab vedotin plus toripalimab as neoadjuvant therapy for HER2-negative muscle-invasive bladder cancer: a case report.
trials.summary: A drug combination helped shrink bladder cancer before surgery in a patient seeking to preserve their bladder.

trials.title: Rapid Exacerbation of Bilateral Hip Osteoarthritis Induced by Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Therapy: A Case Report.
trials.summary: Immune checkpoint inhibitor nivolumab rapidly worsened hip osteoarthritis in a melanoma patient by triggering severe joint inflammation requiring surgery.

trials.title: Predictors of pathologic complete response in triple‑negative breast cancer treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Study identifies tumor stage, Ki-67 expression, BRCA mutations, and immune markers as predictors of treatment success in triple-negative breast cancer.
